# Vendored runtime libraries

Self-hosted so the site has no CDN runtime dependency (zero-build Netlify deploy).

- gsap.min.js — GSAP 3.13.0, gsap standard "no charge" license (GreenSock, now Webflow)
- ScrollTrigger.min.js — GSAP ScrollTrigger plugin 3.13.0, same license
- lenis.min.js — Lenis 1.3.11, MIT license
